name: search-sdk-empty
description: Recorded 2026-10-24 from POST https://app.lobu.ai/api/market/search_sdk (public, keyless; no request headers kept). Query matching no SDK method returns 200 with match_count: 0 and results: [].

body.notes: No method or runtime-helper name matches that wording. Try a namespace (agents, authProfiles, automations, catalog, classifiers, connections, conversations, ctx, devices, entities, entitySchema, feeds, knowledge, metrics, notifications, operations, organizations, schedules, views) or a verb (create, list, search). A method above your access tier is also not listed.
